notes.title: Demo Update & Japanese language support
notes.notes: [p]Thank you so much for all your support! 💖✨[/p][p][/p][p]Whether it’s through wishlisting the game, joining and being active in our Discord server, or showing love with likes and reposts on social media.[/p][p]Even when you leave reviews on the Steam demo page or fill out our feedback form, it truly means a lot![/p][p]Reading your thoughts and chatting with you has been a joy, and it all means the world to our small indie team.[/p][p][/p][p]Right now, K-pop Idol Stories has been selected as one of the Official Selections at BitSummit, Japan’s biggest indie game event.✨[/p][p]The game also joining Dames 4 Games Summer Showcase as an alumni from July 18–25, 2025✨[/p][p][dynamiclink href="http://twitch.tv/Dames4Games"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, we’ll be showcasing our demo with Japanese language support at our booth at[/p][p]Miyako Messe, Kyoto, Japan, from July 18–20, 2025. 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]For those who can’t attend in person, don’t worry...[/p][p]We’re also updating the Steam demo! ☺️💖[/p][p][/p][p]This also means that the full version of the game will include Japanese language support at launch, along with support for other languages like Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Korean, and French.[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 ✨ Here are a few things included in the K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut Version 0.4.425 Demo update:[/p][list][*][p]New: All White Costume.[/p][/*][*][p]New: Japanese language support.[/p][/*][*][p]Major UI adjustment.[/p][/*][*][p]New: trainees status graph.[/p][/*][*][p]New: Benefit difference between the 3 manager types.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved cutscenes and the animation.[/p][/*][*][p]More random events and interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved data and preview in the Schedule tree UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing and adjusting the difficulty in Audition mini games.[/p][/*][*][p]New and improved character's sitting pose.[/p][/*][*][p]New and improved shop items.[/p][/*][*][p]Increase the responsiveness in some mini games, especially the Vocal Rhythm mini game.[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing improvement in data management.[/p][/*][*][p]More informative input prompt display in some UIs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix various game freeze, glitches and bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the issue with ultra wide screen resolution.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41485522/327a541862d5b4dd7df0a4f8ed88cff07850b355.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41485522/9bc38a6e9f578abf39d367bab112038638c5b2f8.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut DEMO is here!
notes.notes:
[b]The DEMO is now available![/b]

Are you ready to accept your new role as an Idol manager?

[b]K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut[/b] is a life simulator where you play as the manager to a new idol group project! 

As the manager it's your responsibility to recruit your idols, plan their schedule, pick their music and even choose their fashion. Put your schedule management skills to the test and help them debut as successful artists!

Try the demo now and start your Kpop manager journey. 

[previewyoutube=7pKllJgxJ0g;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: December 2023 Dev Log: Poll Result
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! 🥰🎶
Welcome to the latest KISS update for December 2023.

Before concluding this year, we would like to share some progress and additions based on the last playtest feedback.

[h2][b][u] Idol Costumes[/u][/b][/h2]

Our team has prepared several costumes for you to choose for your idol group’s debut, and here's one of them:

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/R27XRd9/Minji-ganti-baju.gif[/img]

Some trainees will have similar themed costumes with different styles.

Now, we're curious – which idol group do you think has a great style? Refer them to us for inspiration! Maybe we might use it as a reference for upcoming designs.


[h2][b][u] Review Text History [/u][/b][/h2]

We have added a feature that allows you to revisit the dialogs you have acquired before. 

To start with, here's the initial view (WIP) of the dialog history feature developed by our programmer while awaiting the UI design from the artist:

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/7QHrjt5/devlognov-windowtexthistorywip.jpg[/img]

Then, our artist enhanced its appearance with an appealing UI design:

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/6mXqMrf/Actual-E.png[/img]

We conducted [url=https://twitter.com/WisageniGames/status/1719619789621199049]a poll on Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@wisagenistudio/video/7297216595816910086]TikTok[/url] some time ago. The result was that many feel 5-6 members are the ideal number for a K-pop idol group:

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/DM4J0cZ/Screenshot-2023-11-14-125801.png[/img]

But, how about you? If you missed the poll, feel free to share your thoughts by leaving a comment in the discussion below!

notes.title: Playtest Feedback Responses and GDoC Steam event
notes.notes:
[h3] Hi there, Manager! 📋📋📋 [/h3] 

Thank you to everyone who tried our first playtest build and joined [url=https://discord.gg/PVGKBueRdu]our Discord community[/url].

[b][i]We’ve received all of your feedback[/i][/b]

Let's start with some major feedbacks that we’d like to address for future updates.
But hopefully we can finalize everything soon and having the Demo up.


[h2][b][u]👩🏻‍🤝‍👩🏼👩🏻‍🤝‍👩🏼Feedback 1: Needs more trainees👩🏻‍🤝‍👩🏼👩🏻‍🤝‍👩🏼[/u][/b][/h2]

[img]https://iili.io/JJcEFdF.png[/img]
Yes, we are very excited about this feedback.
Since we will definitely be adding more trainees in the future.
We plan to add three more trainees, and currently all of the characters's characteristic were handcrafted or manually designed by our game and narrative designer.
In this first playtest, we hope to test the feeling of being a manager to better understand and get to know your trainees.❣️🥰 

[img]https://iili.io/JJcATAB.jpg[/img]


[h2][b][u]Feedback 2: English Proofread 📝[/u][/b][/h2]

We feel sorry if you've had any awkward experiences. But no worries, English proofreading is on its way.

Since localization requires a lot of work and cost, while we plan to add more languages in the future. 
Would you kindly let us know which languages you think are important to have? 🙇🏻‍♀️
Chinese Simplified/ Traditional? Japanese? Let us know!


[h2][b][u]🎵 Feedback 3: Rhythm Mini games, QTE and other events 🎵[/u][/b][/h2]

[img]https://iili.io/JJcE2g1.png[/img]
There will be various mini-games prepared for the future depend on the schedules and events happened.
However, we've heard that not everyone is a fan of rhythm games or QTE.🎙️🎵
So, we will provide you with a chance to runaway. 🏃🏻‍♀️💨💨💨
However, in return, there will be some consequences regarding the rewards.

If you've been following our social media, you might have seen a few of them 🤫🔎
We can't wait for you to try them!

[img]https://iili.io/JJcclln.gif[/img]


[h2][b][u]⏰ Feedback 4: The Playtest is too short ⏰ [/u][/b][/h2]

[img]https://iili.io/JJcEd0P.png[/img]
You're right. the current playtest's playtime is only 5 weeks, only half from the initial Demo's planned for 10 weeks long. 📋
But the goal we wanted from playtest is to understand your expectation about the game as early as we can. So if there's some changes, we can do that as early as we can.
While we have built the system, this playtest is just our first baby step.
In the next updates, beside more trainees, we will certainly have longer playtime. 

📣So, please stay tuned for the next announcements.📣

While the playtest is still here until sometime, we will work hard and probably close it when we received enough feedbacks.
But, You can also send your suggestions regarding KISS: Kpop Idol StorieS through our Discord community Anytime!
by clicking through this link  ▶▶ [url=https://discord.gg/PVGKBueRdu ]Join KISS: Kpop Idol StorieS on Discord[/url]

[u][b]Devs streaming is also coming soon this week.[/b][/u]
If you just want to watch, our devs will also stream the playtest build in our page until the Steam VN Fest is over. ːsteamhappyː


[u][h2][b]Rhythm Mini Game - Step by Step[/b][/h2][/u]
Beside Playtest announcement, what we'd like to showcase today is the development journey of one of our minigames, rhythm games.
We've been iterating the gameplay and visuals.

We're fans of [b]DDR (Dance Dance Revolution)[/b] and [b]Pump It Up[/b]-type games.
And this rhythm game is the first thing that came to our minds that fits with the KISS concept, a management simulation about K-pop, idols and music.
So, if you're also the fan of DDR or Pump It Up, we hope that you’ll love this too!

This is the first look of the basic idea of the game. We started with the WASD keys on keyboard.

[img]https://iili.io/HthXUru.gif[/img]


After the game is working, we started to get the 1st looks, and laying out the UI.
From left to centered, we also tried different backgrounds.


[img]https://iili.io/Hthwwmv.gif[/img]


We still wanted to have more K-pop feels in the game.
So we added more polishing and animation, and this is the final look of the game.


[img]https://iili.io/HZiwuiG.gif[/img]

What do you think?
Do you have another mini-game you wanted in mind? ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː
Or guess what's the next mini-games we will add?


[u][h1][b]Schedule Tree[/b][/h1][/u]

Besides the mini-games, we also added a new feature to help players plan a better schedule while playing.

Through the Schedule Tree, you'll be able to see [b]what tasks next[/b] and [b]how to unlock them[/b], giving you clearer ideas on [b]what to choose and focus on[/b] in the game.
The early prototype still a bit messy...

[img]https://iili.io/HthwUrX.gif[/img]

We've tried to clean it up a bit, and voila!
Hope that it's clear enough and informative now. 
As you can see, the Schedule Tree mainly will have 3 big categories. Tehee! ːsteamhappyː

[img]https://iili.io/HthwQQ2.gif[/img]

[u][h1][b]Gamescom and TikTok![/b][/h1][/u]

We’d also like to announce that [url=https://twitter.com/WisageniGames/status/1684389743482802176]KISS: Kpop Idol StorieS - Road to Debut will be joining Gamescom this year[/url].
So if you’re interested in trying the game, have a chit chat with our team at the event, or just say Hi! or Hwaiting! ..kindly [b]visit our booth[/b] at [u][b]Hall 3.02 stand E 018g - F 019g[/b][/u].

Besides [url=https://twitter.com/WisageniGames]our Twitter[/url], now We finally have a [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@wisagenistudio?lang=en]TikTok account[/url].
Not just showing the game.. Sometimes we're also showing the making process, and more about the devs daily life.

[img]https://iili.io/Hthb53F.gif[/img]


So, let's call it a wrap for KISS today’s devlog!

Thank you so much for keep supporting us through the long journey of development.

notes.title: May 2023 Dev Log
notes.notes:
We are so excited to come back with some updates from KISS game development. 
We hope that you are as excited as us! 

Today, we're here to update you on how we created KISS trainee's schedule and phone menu. 
Let us know what you think about it! 🥰


[h2][u]How it all started…[/u][/h2]

Since the game is mainly about scheduling and management, KISS’ schedule and phone layout have been revamped periodically, to bring a more modern approach and feelings about what we all love about K-Pop.


The Schedule menu was looking like this upon the earliest stage of its development: 

[img]https://iili.io/HSDCOXa.png[/img]


This was the early UI made by our programmers back in 2021.


[i][Yes, the development has been running for some time now, since our team has a main project to support KISS development. We also went through a lot of iterations during the production!][/i]



[img]https://iili.io/HSDt0t1.png[/img]


However, we wanted to make it more comfortable to play since we have a group to manage and not just a single character.

We tried to refer at the Princess Maker series and found that putting a single schedule for a day is more comfortable for KISS gameplay mechanics. 



Then we decided to simplify the schedule menu. Take a look at..
[h3][u][b]The latest Schedule UI[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]https://iili.io/HUfXTSp.gif[/img]

We are pretty much happy that the new look now enhances the ambiance to reflect our love for K-Pop and the music itself!


So, that’s a wrap for this month game development update! 
We hope you enjoyed our short 'behind the scenes' for the Schedule menu making. 


[h3][u][b]Stay tuned!![/b][/u][/h3]
 [url=https://twitter.com/WisageniGames]Follow our Twitter and help us spreading the news![/url] 
Let's connect, sometimes we also put some small updates related to the game.

Thank you so much for reading and supporting us this far.
Your support always means a lot to us! 💕  


Xoxo,


Wisageni Studio

notes.notes:
After the page is live sometime back then,
We haven't announced any progress on KISS: KPOP Idol StorieS for a long time.

Recently We have put small updates on our Twitter page,
[b][u][url=https://twitter.com/WisageniGames]Wisageni TWITTER[/url][/u][/b]

But as the production goes deeper, We want to start sharing our progress in a more 'formal' way with the game's followers on Steam.

Thank you for following us all this time.ːsteamhappyː
We are a small studio in a rural area, and your support means a lot to us.


[u][h1]Schedule and Characters[/h1][/u]

We are currently still looking for a good name for these girls!
We have been looking all around, but We also want to hear what our followers think when they see them.
If you managed to have a good Korean girl's name to suggest,
please do so!


[img]https://iili.io/HohkMdv.jpg[/img]



So as a KPOP idol group manager, managing schedules is very important.
Each of the trainees you have in your group will have their hand drawn chibi's form.


[img]https://iili.io/HohkWep.gif[/img]



They will help you show their performance in each schedule that's running the whole week.
Show what they're doing, is it an Amazing performance, or a bad one.
They can slack around.


So it's important for you to keep their happiness, stamina while leveling up their ability until their debut.
Or else, it may delay their debut, or even losing a member.



[img]https://iili.io/Hoh6v5u.gif[/img]



Let us know what do you want to hear from us!
We're more than happy to share our development progress.

That's all for now,
We are working hard, and trying to bring the best for you.

[u][b]See you on the next updates from us and have a nice end of year! [/b][/u]
